slices.title: Frame the level (camera, aspect, player anchor)
slices.feelIntent: Establish the static 16:9 frame and player anchor so every later slice composes inside it.

slices.title: Ground + platform tiling
slices.feelIntent: Solid, correctly-capped tiles with colliders that match the visible surface — no double-cap bands.

slices.title: Player movement + feel
slices.feelIntent: Responsive run/jump with apex/coyote/buffer in-band; the character feels good to move.

slices.title: Parallax background
slices.feelIntent: Seamless, edge-safe multi-layer parallax that shifts with the player and never exposes a gap.

slices.title: Collectibles on the jump arc
slices.feelIntent: Reachable, rewarding pickups placed along the natural movement arc.

slices.title: Hazards
slices.feelIntent: Readable threats with a clear purpose, placed to challenge without feeling unfair.

slices.title: HUD
slices.feelIntent: Clean, anchored HUD elements that read at a glance and match the contract.

slices.title: Juice (dust, hit-stop, shake)
slices.feelIntent: Tactile feedback — landing dust, hit-stop, screen shake — that sells impact without artifacts.

slices.title: End-state (win/lose)
slices.feelIntent: A satisfying win/lose moment with a conformant end-state UI that completes the loop.
